Subject: Security questionnaire
Date: Wednesday 30 September 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Marcus Oyelaran <marcus.oyelaran@thorneveck.example.test>

Marcus,

Quick note so we both have the same picture. You said your team would return the security questionnaire by Friday, and I will watch for it.

Once it lands I can give you a date for the penetration test.

Best,
Dom

expected.description: Marcus Oyelaran team to return the completed security questionnaire
expected.evidenceQuote: You said your team would return the security questionnaire by Friday, and I will watch for it.

notes: An inbound commitment restated in a sent mail. Watching for something is not itself a commitment.
